{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Exclude rows where customer_age is -1 (missing)
valid_ages = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute the mean age of valid entries
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

# Print the result
mean_age"}
